name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
short_description: Move to an island, gather, build, decorate and befriend animal neighbours in real time, across the real seasons.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: Move to an island, gather, build, decorate and befriend animal neighbours in real time, across the real seasons.

identity.core_loop: Wake up, see what changed on the island, gather and catch, sell, buy, decorate, talk to neighbours, come back tomorrow.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Gentle and generous; a day is short and there is always one more small thing.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: The island carries the information: the real clock sets the light, the season, the shop hours and the creatures. Neighbours tell you news. A phone with apps is summoned; the screen is almost empty while you walk.

identity.art_direction: Soft rounded toy-like characters and island, with the world curving away from the camera.

rendering.signature: Soft wrapped light on round chunky toy shapes, with the whole island bent away from the camera like a rolling log so the horizon stays close and cosy.
rendering.source: oracle rendering study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no captures, no game files)
rendering.lesson: Curving the world away from the camera keeps a small place feeling big but safe; we can bend the Ranch the same way in a vertex shader.

tricks: Squat toy-proportioned villagers with bouncy keyed walks and big emotes (reactions) for every mood
Footsteps and run speed change with the ground; the head turns to look at things nearby
motion.lesson: Emotes as a vocabulary: a small set of big readable reactions carries all the social information.
motion.source: oracle motion study 2026-10-23 (public talks, interviews and breakdowns; no game files)

identity.audio_mood: Hourly music that changes through the day; soft footsteps on every ground type.
identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: The real clock and real seasons as the heartbeat; neighbours who notice what you did. Come back tomorrow is a stronger pull than any goal.
